 to $2,000 (2022–23 onward, with $650 for financial-aid applicants). Source: same
 snapshots, "Tuition Deposit:" paragraph.

 states verbatim: "Cannon School will conclude its participation in the North Carolina
 Opportunity Scholarship following the 2025-26 school year." This is a material
 affordability change worth reflecting in the app.
sections.t:

 rive $2,000 (2022–23 anwo, ak $650 pou moun k ap aplike pou èd finansye). Sous: menm
 kaptè yo, paragraf "Tuition Deposit:" la.
- **North Carolina Opportunity Scholarship** — kaptè 2026–27 la (`20260313015924`)
 deklare mo pou mo: "Cannon School will conclude its participation in the North Carolina
 Opportunity Scholarship following the 2025-26 school year." Sa se yon chanjman
 materyèl nan abòdablite ki vo lapèn reflete nan app la.

sections.text: Note on the published 5.0% increase
sections.t: Nòt sou ogmantasyon 5.0% ki pibliye a

sections.text:
The school states that every band rose 5.0% from 2025–26 to 2026–27. The archived
2025–26 figures are close to, but **not identical to**, what a naive 2026–27 ÷ 1.05
calculation would produce — the school rounds each band to a clean figure. Examples:
sections.t:
Lekòl la deklare chak bann te monte 5.0% soti 2025–26 rive 2026–27. Chif 2025–26
ki achive yo pre, men yo **pa idantik**, ak sa yon kalkil naif 2026–27 ÷ 1.05
ta pwodui — lekòl la awondi chak bann nan yon chif pwòp. Egzanp:

sections.text:
This confirms the school's "5.0%" claim is accurate to rounding, and it validates using
the real published figures rather than the derived ones in any year-over-year chart.
sections.t:
Sa konfime reklamasyon "5.0%" lekòl la egzak jiska awondisman, epi li valide sèvi ak
vrè chif ki pibliye yo olye ke sa yo derive nan nenpòt tablo ane apre ane.

sections.text: ### The year-pinning decision
sections.t: ### Desizyon pou fikse ane a

sections.text:
**The app uses 2026-27 ($22,790, grades 9-12)** for `top-tuition` and every
tuition figure in prose, matching the 2026-27 basis used for the six existing
schools. The 2025-26 figures above exist so a reader reconciling against the
payment-terms PDF understands the two live years; no app figure mixes years.
sections.t:
**App la itilize 2026-27 ($22,790, grad 9-12)** pou `top-tuition` ak chak
chif frè eskolè nan pwoz, ki matche ak baz 2026-27 yo itilize pou sis lekòl
ki deja egziste yo. Chif 2025-26 ki anwo yo egziste pou yon lektè k ap rekonsilye
kont PDF kondisyon pèman an konprann de ane an dirèk yo; okenn chif app pa melanje ane.

**gzip-corrupt in the archive** and could not be decoded. It was not needed, since
`20230204193513` covers the same 2023–24 year cleanly.
sections.t:
Nòt: kaptè `20230718230721` nan URL tuition-and-financial-aid la te rekipere men li
**gzip-korompi nan achiv la** epi nou pa t kapab dekode l. Nou pa t bezwen l, paske
`20230204193513` kouvri menm ane 2023–24 la yon fason ki pwòp.

sections.text:
- **Maximum award floor** — verbatim from `20240412152106`: "No financial aid award covers
 the full cost of tuition at Davidson Day School. Families receiving the 'maximum' award
 at Davidson Day are required to pay $3,000 per year, per student for tuition." The same
 $3,000 floor still appears in the 2025–26 snapshot `20250806061814`.
- **Application deadline** — February 15 each year; reapplication required annually.
- **Acclaim Scholars Program** — introduced for the class of 2030 to mark the school's 25th
 anniversary; covers 90% of tuition through graduation contingent on good standing.
 Source: 2026–27 snapshot `20260415013011`.
sections.t:
- **Planche prim maksimòm** — mo pou mo apati `20240412152106`: "No financial aid award covers
 the full cost of tuition at Davidson Day School. Families receiving the 'maximum' award
 at Davidson Day are required to pay $3,000 per year, per student for tuition." Menm
 planche $3,000 la toujou parèt nan kaptè 2025–26 la `20250806061814`.
- **Dat limit aplikasyon** — 15 fevriye chak ane; re-aplikasyon obligatwa chak ane.
- **Acclaim Scholars Program** — entwodui pou klas 2030 la pou make 25yèm
 anivèsè lekòl la; li kouvri 90% nan frè eskolè jiska gradyasyon depann de bon konduit.
 Sous: kaptè 2026–27 `20260415013011`.

sections.text: Tuition and fees 2025-2026
sections.t: Frè eskolè ak frè 2025-2026

sections.text:
**Note on the published "total".** Gaston Day publishes tuition and fees as separate columns
plus an explicit combined total. The Upper School sticker figure is therefore **$22,390**
(tuition $20,215 + fees $2,175) — that combined figure is what third-party sites quote as
the school's tuition, and it is the like-for-like number against other schools' all-in
figures.
sections.t:
**Nòt sou "total" ki pibliye a.** Gaston Day pibliye frè eskolè ak frè yo kòm kolòn apa
plis yon total konbine eksplisit. Kidonk chif afiche Upper School la se **$22,390**
(frè eskolè $20,215 + frè $2,175) — se chif konbine sa a sit twazyèm pati yo site kòm
frè eskolè lekòl la, epi se li ki chif konparab pou pa parèy ak chif tou konpri lòt lekòl yo.

sections.text:
**2026-27 tuition (S2):** **$20,300 – $23,310** depending on grade. Published as a range on
the cost page; the per-grade 2026-27 schedule PDF was not posted at the time of this pass.
sections.t:
**Frè eskolè 2026-27 (S2):** **$20,300 – $23,310** selon grad la. Pibliye kòm yon ranje sou
paj kou a; PDF orè 2026-27 pa grad la pa t afiche nan moman pas sa a.

sections.text: After school & enrichment rates
sections.t: To apre lekòl ak anrichisman

sections.text:
**Rate conflict with the after-school web page — recorded, not silently resolved.** The
`/afterschoolprogram/` page states hours of **3:15 PM – 5:30 PM** and prices of
**$100/month** (Lower School) and **$60/month** (Middle School), with drop-in at $30/day and
$15/day. The tuition schedule (S1) states **3:00–6:00** / **4:00–6:00** at **$95/week** and
**$55/week**, with the same $30/day and $15/day drop-in rates.
sections.t:
**Konfli to ak paj entènèt apre lekòl la — anrejistre, se pa rezoud an silans.** Paj
`/afterschoolprogram/` la deklare orè **3:15 PM – 5:30 PM** ak pri **$100/mwa** (Lower School)
ak **$60/mwa** (Middle School), ak vini yon jou konsa a $30/jou ak
$15/jou. Orè frè eskolè a (S1) deklare **3:00–6:00** / **4:00–6:00** a **$95/semèn** ak
**$55/semèn**, ak menm to $30/jou ak $15/jou pou vini yon jou konsa.

sections.text:
The drop-in rates agree exactly across both sources. The weekly-vs-monthly labels do not:
$100/**month** for daily aftercare would be far below $30/day drop-in economics and below the
schedule's own $95/week, so the page's "/month" reads as a label error for a weekly rate.
Both sources are retained above; the app uses the **official tuition schedule (S1)** as the
rate authority and the **web page (S2/after-school file)** for the current operating window,
which is the more likely thing to have been updated in-year. See the after-school file for
the full page transcription.
sections.t:
To pou vini yon jou konsa yo dakò egzakteman nan toude sous yo. Etikèt pa semèn kont pa mwa yo pa dakò:
$100/**mwa** pou gadri chak jou ta byen anba ekonomi $30/jou vini konsa a epi anba
$95/semèn orè a li menm, kidonk "/mwa" paj la li tankou yon erè etikèt pou yon to pa semèn.
Toude sous yo kenbe anwo a; app la sèvi ak **orè ofisyèl frè eskolè a (S1)** kòm
otorite to a epi ak **paj entènèt la (S2/dosye apre lekòl la)** pou fenèt operasyon aktyèl la,
ki se bagay ki pi posib pou yo te mete ajou nan mitan ane a. Gade dosye apre lekòl la pou
transkripsyon konplè paj la.

sections.text: Financial aid
sections.t: Èd finansye

sections.text:
- **Platform: Clarity** (not FACTS or SSS). Five steps: sign up at the Clarity app; add
 Gaston Day School to the applicant entry; complete the application and pay the **$65**
 fee; complete tax verification (IRS transfer or Clarity's option); submit and monitor the
 dashboard for document requests.
- **Deadline: rolling** — "The financial aid deadline is rolling, but funds may become
 limited or unavailable towards the beginning of the new school year (August)."
- **Three assistance channels:** need-based Financial Aid, Merit Scholarships, and the
 **North Carolina Opportunity Scholarship**.
- **Discount ceiling: up to 80%** of tuition (Kindergarten–Grade 12).
- **Contact:** Kevin Napp, Director of Admissions, 704.864.7744 ext. 414.
sections.t:
- **Platfòm: Clarity** (se pa FACTS ni SSS). Senk etap: enskri sou app Clarity a; ajoute
 Gaston Day School nan antre moun k ap aplike a; ranpli aplikasyon an epi peye frè **$65**
 la; ranpli verifikasyon taks (transfè IRS oswa opsyon Clarity a); soumèt epi siveye
 tablodbò a pou demann dokiman.
- **Dat limit: woulan** — "The financial aid deadline is rolling, but funds may become
 limited or unavailable towards the beginning of the new school year (August)."
- **Twa kanal asistans:** Financial Aid ki baze sou bezwen, Merit Scholarships, ak
 **North Carolina Opportunity Scholarship** lan.
- **Plafon rabè: jiska 80%** nan frè eskolè a (Kindergarten–Grade 12).
- **Kontak:** Kevin Napp, Director of Admissions, 704.864.7744 ext. 414.

sections.text:
**Not published** on any page found in this pass: the total aid budget in dollars, the
average award, the number of families receiving aid, sibling discounts, tuition-insurance
or refund-plan terms, and the payment-plan tiers (S1 states only that "Gaston Day offers a
variety of payment plans" and that all plans assume the tuition deposit and fees have been
paid). These are recorded as confirmed absences, not as unresearched gaps.
sections.t:
**Pa pibliye** sou okenn paj nou jwenn nan pas sa a: bidjè èd total la an dola,
bous mwayèn nan, kantite fanmi k ap resevwa èd, rabè pou frè ak sè, kondisyon asirans frè eskolè
oswa plan ranbousman, ak palye plan peman yo (S1 di sèlman ke "Gaston Day offers a
variety of payment plans" epi ke tout plan yo sipoze depo frè eskolè a ak frè yo peye deja).
Sa yo anrejistre kòm absans konfime, se pa kòm twou ki pa rechèche.

sections.text: Aid share
sections.t: Pòsyon èd

sections.text: **26% of the student body receives tuition assistance** (2025-26 Academic Profile).
sections.t: **26% nan kò elèv la resevwa asistans pou frè eskolè** (Academic Profile 2025-26).

sections.text:
S5 (Private School Review) reports **45%**. The school's own profile is used. The two are
also not measuring the same quantity: the profile's "tuition assistance" is need-based aid,
while a third-party "percent on financial aid" figure commonly folds in merit awards and
state Opportunity Scholarship recipients — which at Gaston Day are three separate channels
(S2). The gap is therefore plausibly definitional rather than either figure being wrong.
sections.t:
S5 (Private School Review) rapòte **45%**. Se pwòp pwofil lekòl la nou sèvi. De yo pa
ap mezire menm kantite a non plis: "tuition assistance" pwofil la se èd ki baze sou bezwen,
tandiske yon chif twazyèm pati "pousantaj sou èd finansye" anjeneral mete ansanm bous merit ak
moun k ap resevwa Opportunity Scholarship eta a — ki nan Gaston Day se twa kanal apa
(S2). Kidonk diferans lan gen anpil chans se yon zafè definisyon olye ke youn nan chif yo pa kòrèk.

sections.text:
These are third-party figures (Private School Review) and are not confirmed by a school
publication; they are carried with that caveat and flagged for verification where surfaced.
sections.t:
Sa yo se chif twazyèm pati (Private School Review) epi yon piblikasyon lekòl la pa konfime yo;
nou pote yo ak avètisman sa a epi nou make yo pou verifikasyon kote yo parèt.

sections.t: Bous ki gen non

sections.text:
The W. Duke Kimbrell Scholarship is the school's **highest honor** and is full-tuition —
notable because a 100%-of-tuition merit award is uncommon on this roster.
sections.t:
W. Duke Kimbrell Scholarship la se **pi gwo onè** lekòl la epi li kouvri tout frè eskolè a —
sa remakab paske yon bous merit ki kouvri 100% frè eskolè a pa komen sou lis sa a.
